# Field Service Operations Platform

## Executive Summary

The company dispatches crews from a whiteboard and bills from paper tickets, and
the distance between the two is where the margin goes.

## Financial Analysis

### Current State

The company reported LTM revenue of $61.0M and adjusted EBITDA of $7.3M, an
adjusted EBITDA margin of 12.0% for the same period.

Crews are dispatched from a whiteboard rebuilt every morning, and the rebuild
takes two dispatchers most of the first hour of every shift.

Tickets are written on paper and keyed into the billing system days later, so a
disputed line cannot be answered while the crew is still on site.

Nobody can say which branches are running below margin until the month closes.

### Projected Impact

| Case | Incremental Annual EBITDA | EBITDA Margin Impact (pp) |
|---|---|---|
| Conservative | $0.9M | 1.1pp |
| Base Case | $1.8M | 2.2pp |
| Optimistic | $2.9M | 3.6pp |

Billing lag falls from nine days to one, and dispatch time per shift falls under
ten minutes at steady state.

## The Proposed Solution

A mobile ticket capture app records the work at the job site, so the ticket
leaves with the crew rather than arriving days later.

A scheduling service holds one live dispatch board every branch reads from,
replacing the whiteboard rebuilt each morning.

A billing integration posts the captured ticket into the accounting system
already in place, the night it is signed.

### Technical Requirements

An operations data store joins the captured tickets to the financials, so
job-level margin is readable the day a job closes.

Reporting runs on that store, with a dispatcher view, a branch manager view and
a finance view over the same numbers.

## Implementation Approach

### Timeline

| Phase | Timeline | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| **Phase 1: Capture** | Months 1-4 | Ship the mobile ticket app to one branch |
| **Phase 2: Dispatch** | Months 4-8 | Replace the whiteboard with the live board |
| **Phase 3: Reporting** | Months 8-14 | Stand up the data store and the three views |

The whole programme runs 14 months from approval to the last view shipping.

## Next Steps

Leadership approves the scope and the phased plan before any build begins.

The finance team supplies read access to the accounting system so the billing
integration can be built against it.

Operations names the branch that runs the first phase.

### Resources Required
